notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Embrose.
Embrose does not have summoning sickness.
You control another creature with toughness equal to 1.
description:
Activate Embrose by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on another creature you control with toughness equal to 1, and then dealing 2 damage to that creature.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Pitiless Plunderer, Animation Module and Embrose trigger.
Resolve the Embrose trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
